Action Plan

Adopt this five-step checklist for every new LLM feature

  1. Define task scope: input, output format and constraints
  2. Choose prompt patterns: few-shot, chain-of-thought or structured
  3. Write eval criteria: accuracy, consistency and token efficiency
  4. Run your test suite: edge cases over 3–5 iteration cycles
  5. Document the winning prompt: the prompt, its rationale and its eval results
Measure every prompt change against the eval criteria
Automate the test suite so it runs on every edit
Safeguard the winning prompt under review
Start this sprint: apply the checklist to your next LLM feature, with no new tooling required.
